record_model._what: Proposed record_model DATA for restoring the existing shared space membership owner. This is a generic membership model: events are rows with label 'event', never an event-specific record kind.

membership.logical_identity: value.id (old memberships.id; event ids remain event_id)

required_external_bindings.request: No current records-backed accepted join-request owner is available. Do not add a network-request kind or reuse intake requests. The adapter may omit this binding: member.admitted_by_invitation still proves admission, while a membership path that needs otherwise-unavailable accepted-request evidence fails explicitly as unavailable.
required_external_bindings.rules: Bind the existing space-rules owner declared by decide-who-may-do-what-in-a-space.
required_external_bindings.own_member_type: Bind the existing space-member-type owner declared by decide-who-may-do-what-in-a-space.
required_external_bindings.show_rule_document: Bind the existing space-show-rule-types document owner declared by decide-who-may-do-what-in-a-space.

commit_contract.event_revision: Every RSVP increments the event membership revision in the same conditional batch as its member-row write. This serializes last-seat races.
commit_contract.auth_readset: Fresh auth snapshots and expected record values join event/member expected values in one records:write batch.
commit_contract.remove_event: Event and all RSVP member records are removed in one batch; refuse before writing if the declared max_writes would be exceeded.
